From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com

Subject: Sequenced onramp: tranche gating & requested cloud buffer for DEAL-3487

Hi Maria / BigCloud team,

Quick context: StellarAI (DEAL-3487) is asking for a dedicated onramp of 120 GPUs for production over a 4-month window starting in Q1. We need a tranche-aligned procurement approach so the customer's go-live isn't blocked by a single long lead-time shipment.

Ask: can ChipWorks provide a lead-time breakdown by SKU and the minimum tranche sizes you can commit to for partial shipments? Specifically:
- ETA ranges for A100-gen2 and H100 SKUs (weeks from PO)
- Ability to split a 120-unit order into 3 tranches (suggested 40/40/40) with partial shipping to match our staged onboarding
- Deposit schedule or reservation path to lock manufacturing lanes (deposit %, PO cadence)
- Any customs/port lead-time risk we should bake into dates

On our side we plan to keep a cloud buffer (roughly 30% of initial demand) via BigCloud reserved capacity for the first 90 days to avoid user impact while hardware arrives and racks. BigCloud account exec is looped here — please confirm whether that buffer can be held on a short-term reserved contract and cost delta.

I've attached a rough onramp_capacity_schedule.xlsx and a deal_stocking_model.csv. Maria — if you can return a preliminary quote (CW-Quote-DEAL-3487.pdf) showing tranche pricing and lead-time windows that'd be perfect. Also flag any minimum tranche you need (we prefer smaller partial shipments).

Timeline request: we'd like initial tranche confirmation and a draft quote by EOD Tue Oct 13 so we can align credit/PO with StellarAI procurement.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas — thanks for the clear ask. High level responses below and a few questions.

Lead-time windows (typical, subject to factory schedule at time of PO):
- A100-gen2 (CW-A100G2): 14–20 weeks from PO
- H100 (CW-H100): 18–24 weeks from PO

Tranche options and minimums:
- We can do partial shipments. Minimum firm tranche is 30 units for a single shipment; however, with a 30% deposit per tranche we can guarantee earlier slotting and break a 120 order into 30/30/30/30 if needed.
- Alternate split (40/40/40) is doable but would require a larger single-slot commitment (we prioritize >40 per tranche normally).

Reservation and deposit:
- To secure earlier factory lanes we require a 25–30% deposit per tranche and a confirmed PO with target ship windows.
- Flexible cancellation windows exist but will incur restocking fees depending on raw-material commitments.

Pricing notes:
- Preliminary unit pricing included in attachment: CW-Quote-DEAL-3487.pdf (list price + volume discounts at 40/80/120 thresholds).

Customs/ports:
- Current risk: Pacific port congestion could add 2–3 weeks if shipments require trans-Pacific routing; expedited air freight options quoted separately.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Is the 30% cloud buffer a hard requirement for StellarAI or a recommendation?
2) Can Redwood sign a staged PO/commitment schedule (we need purchase milestones to hold lanes)?

Thanks Maria — useful. Quick internal read and proposal:

1) Hybrid buffer plan (recommended)
- Keep 36 vGPU-equivalent capacity (30% of 120) on BigCloud reserved instances for 90 days. BigCloud account_exec has offered a 3-month convertible reservation at a small premium vs 12-month RIs. This covers day-1 demand and first tranche provisioning risk.

2) ChipWorks tranche commitment
- We should accept the 30-unit minimum per shipment option with a deposit schedule (25% per tranche). That gives us more flexibility and keeps lanes open.

3) Cost tradeoffs
- Buffer cost model attached (buffer_cost_model.xlsx) — rough delta $/token equivalence vs on-prem unit once installed. Early numbers show buffer is cheaper than a missed SLA in first 30 days for StellarAI.

Action items I recommend:
- Confirm deposit approach with ChipWorks (25% per tranche)
- Ask Procurement to issue staged PO template that maps to the tranche schedule (we can create the template)
- Ask CS to prepare an expedited onboarding runbook for the hybrid model

If we can get Maria to confirm tranche minimums + deposit terms by Tue (Oct 13) we can lock slots and present the combined quote to StellarAI for signature.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
